Now, food banks are seeing the impact firsthand. The Society of St. Vincent de Paul says demand for emergency food assistance has more than doubled, with families lining up before sunrise for help putting food on the table.

The decline comes as states implement changes following the Republican reconciliation law signed by Donald Trump in July 2025, which enacted the largest SNAP cut in the program’s history. Nationwide, SNAP participation fell by more than 4.5 million people between July 2025 and April 2026.
